fullText.simplified:
第1章、幸福一家人

    七号大街的尽头有一个漂亮的小楼，楼里住着一家人，爸爸高一夏、妈妈易美、儿子高尔和女儿高星星。住在这条街上的人都说，他们是七号大街最幸福的一家人。如果你经常路过七号大街，你一定听到过大家对他们这样的赞美。
    “高一夏和易美是世界上最温柔的爸爸和妈妈，他们好爱他们的孩子！”
    “高尔的性格太好了！他是世界上最懂事的儿子，如果我儿子有高尔一半懂事就好了。”
    “高星星真漂亮！她弹钢琴的样子，就像一位公主！”
    爸爸高一夏很喜欢听这样的话，这些赞美可以让他从早到晚都有好心情。妈妈易美的身体不太好，但她性格温柔。每次听到别人的赞美，她总是温柔地说：“哪里哪里，您的孩子也很优秀。”妹妹高星星最可爱，她长得像妈妈，但性格像爸爸，她最喜欢听别人说她像公主。
    哥哥高尔和妈妈的性格有点儿像。听到大家的赞美后，他会开心地说“谢谢”，然后笑着走开，去忙工作。高尔在一家家具公司工作。这个工作很忙，需要经常出差，是个非常累人的活儿。很多年轻人都不愿意做这么辛苦的工作，但高尔做得不错，好像每天都有用不完的力气。
    家里只有高尔一个人工作。爸爸高一夏以前有家旅游公司，但生意不好，七年前就已经关门了，关门的时候还欠了银行一大笔钱。从那以后，高一夏就没有再工作了，他一下子老了十多岁，像个没力气的老人，大事小事都需要人照顾。那时候的高尔才十六岁，刚刚上高一。为了照顾家人，高尔离开了学校。
fullText.traditional:
第1章、幸福一家人

    七號大街的盡頭有一個漂亮的小樓，樓裡住著一家人，爸爸高一夏、媽媽易美、兒子高爾和女兒高星星。住在這條街上的人都說，他們是七號大街最幸福的一家人。如果你經常路過七號大街，你一定聽到過大家對他們這樣的讚美。
    “高一夏和易美是世界上最溫柔的爸爸和媽媽，他們好愛他們的孩子！”
    “高爾的性格太好了！他是世界上最懂事的兒子，如果我兒子有高爾一半懂事就好了。”
    “高星星真漂亮！她彈鋼琴的樣子，就像一位公主！”
    爸爸高一夏很喜歡聽這樣的話，這些讚美可以讓他從早到晚都有好心情。媽媽易美的身體不太好，但她性格溫柔。每次聽到別人的讚美，她總是溫柔地說：“哪裡哪裡，您的孩子也很優秀。”妹妹高星星最可愛，她長得像媽媽，但性格像爸爸，她最喜歡聽別人說她像公主。
    哥哥高爾和媽媽的性格有點兒像。聽到大家的讚美後，他會開心地說“謝謝”，然後笑著走開，去忙工作。高爾在一家家具公司工作。這個工作很忙，需要經常出差，是個非常累人的活兒。很多年輕人都不願意做這麼辛苦的工作，但高爾做得不錯，好像每天都有用不完的力氣。
    家裡只有高爾一個人工作。爸爸高一夏以前有家旅遊公司，但生意不好，七年前就已經關門了，關門的時候還欠了銀行一大筆錢。從那以後，高一夏就沒有再工作了，他一下子老了十多歲，像個沒力氣的老人，大事小事都需要人照顧。那時候的高爾才十六歲，剛剛上高一。為了照顧家人，高爾離開了學校。

sentences.english: In the little house lived a family: father Gao Yixia, mother Yi Mei, son Gao Er, and daughter Gao Xingxing.

sentences.simplified: 住在这条街上的人都说，他们是七号大街最幸福的一家人。
sentences.traditional: 住在這條街上的人都說，他們是七號大街最幸福的一家人。

sentences.english: The people living on this street all said that they were the happiest family on Seventh Street.

sentences.simplified: 如果你经常路过七号大街，你一定听到过大家对他们这样的赞美。
sentences.traditional: 如果你經常路過七號大街，你一定聽到過大家對他們這樣的讚美。

sentences.english: If you often passed by Seventh Street, you would have heard people praising them like this.

sentences.simplified: “高一夏和易美是世界上最温柔的爸爸和妈妈，他们好爱他们的孩子！”
sentences.traditional: “高一夏和易美是世界上最溫柔的爸爸和媽媽，他們好愛他們的孩子！”
sentences.pinyin: gāo yī xià hé yì měi shì shì jiè shang zuì wēn róu de bà ba hé mā ma tā men hǎo ài tā men de hái zi
sentences.english: “Gao Yixia and Yi Mei are the most gentle father and mother in the world. They love their children so much!”

sentences.simplified: “高尔的性格太好了！
sentences.traditional: “高爾的性格太好了！
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr de xìng gé tài hǎo le
sentences.english: “Gao Er has such a great personality!

sentences.simplified: 他是世界上最懂事的儿子，如果我儿子有高尔一半懂事就好了。”
sentences.traditional: 他是世界上最懂事的兒子，如果我兒子有高爾一半懂事就好了。”
sentences.pinyin: tā shì shì jiè shang zuì dǒng shì de ér zi rú guǒ wǒ ér zi yǒu gāo ěr yí bàn dǒng shì jiù hǎo le
sentences.english: He is the most well-behaved son in the world. If my son were half as well-behaved as Gao Er, I would be happy.”

sentences.simplified: “高星星真漂亮！她弹钢琴的样子，就像一位公主！”
sentences.traditional: “高星星真漂亮！她彈鋼琴的樣子，就像一位公主！”

sentences.english: “Gao Xingxing is so pretty! When she plays the piano, she looks like a princess!”

sentences.simplified: 爸爸高一夏很喜欢听这样的话，这些赞美可以让他从早到晚都有好心情。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸高一夏很喜歡聽這樣的話，這些讚美可以讓他從早到晚都有好心情。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba gāo yī xià hěn xǐ huan tīng zhè yàng de huà zhè xiē zàn měi kě yǐ ràng tā cóng zǎo dào wǎn dōu yǒu hǎo xīn qíng
sentences.english: Father Gao Yixia really liked hearing such words. These compliments could keep him in a good mood from morning till night.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈易美的身体不太好，但她性格温柔。
sentences.traditional: 媽媽易美的身體不太好，但她性格溫柔。
sentences.pinyin: mā ma yì měi de shēn tǐ bú tài hǎo dàn tā xìng gé wēn róu
sentences.english: Mother Yi Mei’s health was not very good, but she had a gentle personality.

sentences.simplified: 每次听到别人的赞美，她总是温柔地说：“哪里哪里，您的孩子也很优秀。”
sentences.traditional: 每次聽到別人的讚美，她總是溫柔地說：“哪裡哪裡，您的孩子也很優秀。”

sentences.english: Every time she heard others’ compliments, she always said gently, “You’re too kind, your child is outstanding, too.”

sentences.simplified: 妹妹高星星最可爱，她长得像妈妈，但性格像爸爸，
sentences.traditional: 妹妹高星星最可愛，她長得像媽媽，但性格像爸爸，
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei gāo xīng xing zuì kě ài tā zhǎng de xiàng mā ma dàn xìng gé xiàng bà ba
sentences.english: Little sister Gao Xingxing was really cute. She looked like her mother, but her personality was like her father’s.

sentences.simplified: 她最喜欢听别人说她像公主。
sentences.traditional: 她最喜歡聽別人說她像公主。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuì xǐ huan tīng bié ren shuō tā xiàng gōng zhǔ
sentences.english: She loved it when people said that she looked like a princess.

sentences.simplified: 哥哥高尔和妈妈的性格有点儿像。
sentences.traditional: 哥哥高爾和媽媽的性格有點兒像。
sentences.pinyin: gē ge gāo ěr hé mā ma de xìng gé yǒu diǎn'r xiàng
sentences.english: Older brother Gao Er’s personality was a bit like his mother’s.

sentences.simplified: 听到大家的赞美后，他会开心地说“谢谢”，然后笑着走开，去忙工作。
sentences.traditional: 聽到大家的讚美後，他會開心地說“謝謝”，然後笑著走開，去忙工作。
sentences.pinyin: tīng dào dà jiā de zàn měi hòu tā huì kāi xīn de shuō xiè xie rán hòu xiào zhe zǒu kāi qù máng gōng zuò
sentences.english: After hearing everyone’s compliments, he would happily say “thank you”, then walk away with a smile and get back to work.

sentences.traditional: 高爾在一家家具公司工作。這個工作很忙，需要經常出差，是個非常累人的活兒。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr zài yì jiā jiā jù gōng sī gōng zuò zhè ge gōng zuò hěn máng xū yào jīng cháng chū chāi shì ge fēi cháng lèi rén de huó'r
sentences.english: Gao Er worked at a furniture company. This job was very busy and required frequent travel. It was really tiring work.

sentences.simplified: 很多年轻人都不愿意做这么辛苦的工作，但高尔做得不错，好像每天都有用不完的力气。
sentences.traditional: 很多年輕人都不願意做這麼辛苦的工作，但高爾做得不錯，好像每天都有用不完的力氣。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō nián qīng rén dōu bú yuàn yì zuò zhè me xīn kǔ de gōng zuò dàn gāo ěr zuò de bú cuò hǎo xiàng měi tiān dōu yǒu yòng bù wán de lì qi
sentences.english: Many young people were unwilling to do such demanding work, but Gao Er did it well, seeming to have endless energy every day.

sentences.simplified: 家里只有高尔一个人工作。
sentences.traditional: 家裡只有高爾一個人工作。
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ zhǐ yǒu gāo ěr yí ge rén gōng zuò
sentences.english: Gao Er was the only one working in the family.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸高一夏以前有家旅游公司，但生意不好，
sentences.traditional: 爸爸高一夏以前有家旅遊公司，但生意不好，

sentences.english: His father Gao Yixia used to have a travel company, but business wasn’t good.

sentences.simplified: 七年前就已经关门了，关门的时候还欠了银行一大笔钱。
sentences.traditional: 七年前就已經關門了，關門的時候還欠了銀行一大筆錢。
sentences.pinyin: qī nián qián jiù yǐ jīng guān mén le guān mén de shí hou hái qiàn le yín háng yí dà bǐ qián
sentences.english: It closed down seven years ago, and when it closed, it still owed the bank a large sum of money.

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，高一夏就没有再工作了，
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，高一夏就沒有再工作了，
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu gāo yī xià jiù méi yǒu zài gōng zuò le
sentences.english: Gao Yixia hadn’t worked since then.

sentences.simplified: 他一下子老了十多岁，像个没力气的老人，大事小事都需要人照顾。
sentences.traditional: 他一下子老了十多歲，像個沒力氣的老人，大事小事都需要人照顧。
sentences.pinyin: tā yí xià zi lǎo le shí duō suì xiàng ge méi lì qi de lǎo rén dà shì xiǎo shì dōu xū yào rén zhào gù
sentences.english: He suddenly aged more than ten years, like an old man without any strength who needed help with everything, big or small.

sentences.simplified: 那时候的高尔才十六岁，刚刚上高一。
sentences.traditional: 那時候的高爾才十六歲，剛剛上高一。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí hou de gāo ěr cái shí liù suì gāng gāng shàng gāo yī
sentences.english: At that time, Gao Er was only sixteen and had just started his first year of senior high school.

sentences.simplified: 为了照顾家人，高尔离开了学校。
sentences.traditional: 為了照顧家人，高爾離開了學校。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le zhào gù jiā rén gāo ěr lí kāi le xué xiào
sentences.english: To take care of his family, Gao Er left school.

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: A Happy Family
At the end of Seventh Street, there was a beautiful little house.
In the little house lived a family: father Gao Yixia, mother Yi Mei, son Gao Er, and daughter Gao Xingxing.
The people living on this street all said that they were the happiest family on Seventh Street.
If you often passed by Seventh Street, you would have heard people praising them like this.
“Gao Yixia and Yi Mei are the most gentle father and mother in the world. They love their children so much!”
“Gao Er has such a great personality!
He is the most well-behaved son in the world. If my son were half as well-behaved as Gao Er, I would be happy.”
“Gao Xingxing is so pretty! When she plays the piano, she looks like a princess!”
Father Gao Yixia really liked hearing such words. These compliments could keep him in a good mood from morning till night.
Mother Yi Mei’s health was not very good, but she had a gentle personality.
Every time she heard others’ compliments, she always said gently, “You’re too kind, your child is outstanding, too.”
Little sister Gao Xingxing was really cute. She looked like her mother, but her personality was like her father’s.
She loved it when people said that she looked like a princess.
Older brother Gao Er’s personality was a bit like his mother’s.
After hearing everyone’s compliments, he would happily say “thank you”, then walk away with a smile and get back to work.
Gao Er worked at a furniture company. This job was very busy and required frequent travel. It was really tiring work.
Many young people were unwilling to do such demanding work, but Gao Er did it well, seeming to have endless energy every day.
Gao Er was the only one working in the family.
His father Gao Yixia used to have a travel company, but business wasn’t good.
It closed down seven years ago, and when it closed, it still owed the bank a large sum of money.
Gao Yixia hadn’t worked since then.
He suddenly aged more than ten years, like an old man without any strength who needed help with everything, big or small.
At that time, Gao Er was only sixteen and had just started his first year of senior high school.
To take care of his family, Gao Er left school.
